## Facts
- Node.js 20+, Express 5, SQLite (node:sqlite, WAL), SSE, vanilla JS SPA.
- AI via local Ollama (chat/vision/embeddings), optional Silero TTS / faster-whisper.
- Upload: 50 MB default; 500 MB with an active subscription.
- PWA, Android APK, Windows EXE; offline read-only mode.
- License: AGPL-3.0-only.
